complete_examples.text: The sensitivity and reliability assessment of the cumulative settlement under the cases of different speed, train load and soil strength are investi gated by numerical examples to illustrate the robustness of the proposed method.

To illustrate the applicability of the random evolution and uncertainty quantification model of train-induced subgrade settlement, and reveal the main influencing factors of CS, the PDF evolu tion of stochastic responses, sensitivity analysis and reliability assessment are performed.
